Drug interactions of mood stabilizers
ZUO Xiao-cong, LIU Yu-lan, WU Cui-fang, ZHANG Bi-kui(Department of Pharmacy, the Xiangya Third Hospital, Central South University, Changsha HU-NAN 410013, China)[ABSTRACT] Mood stabilizers are generally used as combination with another mood stabilizer, antipsychotic drugs, antidepressive drugs, or other drugs in the clinical application. Lithium salt and antiepileptic drugs are extensively used as mood stabilizers. Drug interactions may be generated in the physiological disposition while multiple drugs jointing. This article reviews the interactions of mood stabilizers with other combined drugs in the aspects of pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics so as to provide effective drug information for clinic.心境稳定剂（mood stabilizers），或称情感稳定性药物（mood stabilizing drugs），是一类对双相情感障碍躁狂及抑郁症状具有双向调节、稳定病情、预防复发作用的药物。心境稳定剂在临床应用中，普遍存在联合应用现象，不仅有多种心境稳定剂的合用，也有与抗精神病药、抗抑郁药的合用，还有心境稳定剂本身作为辅助用药
